text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Dober invites me to<n>go shopping
with her and Mejiro<n>Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is that music? It sounds like it's<n>coming from over
there...

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Taiki Shuttle only<n>scored eighty-nine
points! Looks like<n>the grand prize of a premium
steak is<n>still up for grabs!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shoot! And here I was plannin'<n>on havin' a
barbecue with everyone<n>tonight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober, I'm beggin' ya! Do this<n>karaoke challenge
with me, please!

text_block_list.name: People in the Shopping District
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it looks like there's going to be<n>a new
contender. Let's stay and<n>watch her performance
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... Sorry, I'd love to help, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Hang on. Taiki, would it be all<n>right if I joined
you instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan's so considerate... Whenever<n>I'm
uncomfortable, she always offers<n>to do things in
my stead.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But, at this rate, I'll end up relying on<n>her forever...

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
We're still open to new challengers,<n>folks! Who
would like to take on the<n>karaoke challenge and
bring home<n>that steak?!
choice_data_list: Why not accept Ryan's kind offer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What?! But there's too many people<n>here. She
shouldn't—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, it's okay, Ryan. I want to try. I'll<n>give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Put your hands together for our next<n>challenger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm Mejiro Dober. I'm going to singHere Comes Our Time... with myfriend...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-hold on, are you sure about this,<n>Dober?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The karaoke machine starts playing<n>music, and the
eyes of everyone in<n>the shopping district turn to
Mejiro<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! That's Mejiro Dober! I<n>love her
singing!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
What is she going to sing? Do you<n>think it'll be all
right if I take a video?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Dober! Just pretend this is a concert!
Dober! Just pretend this is a concert!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A concert...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You can do this! Your fans<n>always feel
your gratitude for their<n>support in your performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I know you'll be great—I<n>guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You never know how fate will unfold.<n>When you
meet a brand-new friend...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Great job, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're growing braver by the day. I<n>could learn a
thing or two from you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Singing karaoke in the middle of the<n>town might not
be a big deal to some,<n>but for Mejiro Dober, it's
proof of<n>how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention she managed to score<n>over ninety
points and won the<n>premium steak! Afterward, the
four of<n>us have a party together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (This is so embarrassing!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You never know how fate will unfold.<n>When you
meet a brand-new friend...
choice_data_list: A new door opens, and off you two go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ryan? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You've taken a really courageous<n>step forward,
and that's an incredible<n>feat in and of itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes, it can be hard to be<n>brave alone.
When that happens, it's<n>okay to get help from
others as you<n>slowly get used to putting yourself
out there.
choice_data_list: Why don't we sing the rest of the song together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Look, the melody is starting again! As<n>my heart
pounds like a beating drum I<n>want to know, what is
this feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Does this mean our time has finally<n>come?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right now, that moment seems so far<n>away. ♪

text_block_list.name: Dober and Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But we realize that some way,<n>somehow Our
journeys will lead us<n>there some day!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although they didn't manage to score<n>above ninety
points, they gained<n>something far more valuable
from the<n>experience than a premium steak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Are you a mind reader?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I wanted to offer advice since you looked so
lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, did I just say that out loud?!
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I wanted to offer advice since you looked so
lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list:
You can try next time once you're more mentally
ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ready? What are you guys<n>talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing. I'm just not very<n>brave, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you're talking<n>about, but you're
definitely capable of<n>being brave when the situation
calls<n>for it, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So whenever you're ready, I want<n>you to give it all
you've got. I'll be<n>rooting for you too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
